blind.description: A crude, rustic wooden multi-tier bunk bed with chunky square corner posts and rough horizontal slats joined with iron rivets. Each of the three tiers is packed with straw bedding and topped with a rustic brown animal hide or leather pelt blanket. A small three-rung wooden ladder is fixed to the front frame. Painted in a stylized hand-painted fantasy art style with natural brown wood, mossy green stains, golden straw, and reddish-brown hides.
blind.from_above: A rectangular wooden border with four corner post finials, framing a straw mattress covered by an irregular reddish-brown animal pelt blanket, with the top of a wooden ladder slightly protruding from the lower long side.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 4 feet tall (roughly two-thirds the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 4 to 4.5 feet long.
